description: 🚀 Join Our NASA Space Apps Challenge Team!We're building a team of curious, creative, and ambitious individuals who are passionate about space, science, technology, and innovation.You don't need to be an expert or a professional programmer. What matters is your creativity, willingness to learn, teamwork, and enthusiasm for solving real-world challenges.Whether you're interested in coding, design, research, science, presentation, or creative problem-solving, there's a place for you on our team!
